scope.purpose: Inventory 21 literal production-CLI startup rejection cases for later integration into the full H2 gate.
scope.acceptance_limit: Derivative inventory only. This is not an execution authorization or standalone gate, and no runtime result is claimed. It does not replace the full H2 crash/history-loss inventory or acceptance.

timing.coverage: The protocol watchdog starts before test fixture setup; the shared cleanup window begins before fixture teardown. No Temporal service is started in these rejection cases.

scope.source_validation: Static authoring only: Python AST parse and whitespace checks passed. No project imports, collection, test execution, DB, service, or network operations were performed.

method: For each exact node ID, construct a private real runtime configuration and initial owner registration state, launch the production execution_runtime CLI in dispatcher or worker mode, and require exit code 3 with the fixed DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE stdout and empty stderr. Passive listeners cover the selected loopback endpoints and record zero incoming connections; endpoint_mismatch uses distinct listeners for the configured and registered endpoints and records both independently. For accepted-job cases, compare independent owner snapshots before/after and require the accepted create command to remain pending at generation zero with no attempts, binding, scope, or receipt. The no-job case omits registration and job creation, and independently requires all eight tracked table counts to remain zero.
agent: TC owns the startup test, deadline plugin, and this derivative inventory. Root owns full-gate integration and authorization. No execution is authorized or claimed here.

cases.purpose: Reject missing startup registration before any job or binding exists.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI; no deployment/principal/build mapping and no accepted job.
cases.method: Skip job creation and workspace provisioning; confirm all eight table counts are zero, then launch with an identity naming the absent deployment.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response, empty stderr, zero connections to the selected passive listener, and identical all-zero counts after startup rejection.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; all eight counts remain zero.
cases.evidence: Private per-case process journal, fixed-output digests, listener count, and before/after count record.
cases.recovery: Preserve private evidence; allow isolated DB/workspace fixture teardown; do not create a replacement registration or job to make startup pass.

cases.purpose: Reject a missing deployment mapping for an already accepted create.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI and a real accepted, physically READY job with no deployment row.
cases.method: Create the job through G4 HTTP, provision G5 READY through WorkspaceService, omit the deployment during initial owner registration, and launch the dispatcher.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero selected-endpoint connections; exact owner snapshot unchanged with pending generation-zero outbox and no execution rows.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private owner snapshots and workspace fingerprint, process journal/output digests, and passive-listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve the case evidence and let the per-test database drop; do not add deployment state after observing failure.

cases.purpose: Reject a disabled deployment mapping.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with an initially inserted disabled deployment and accepted READY job.
cases.method: Insert the deployment disabled from the outset, register its build/principals, and run the dispatcher against a passive endpoint.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero endpoint connections and no mutation to accepted job, pending outbox, workspace, or execution rows.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, CLI journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and drop the isolated DB; do not enable the deployment to turn rejection into success.

cases.purpose: Reject a registered deployment/build without a dispatcher principal.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with deployment and build rows but no dispatcher principal row.
cases.method: Build the initial owner registry omitting only the dispatcher principal, preserve the accepted READY job, and launch the dispatcher.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero endpoint connections; accepted/outbox/workspace state unchanged and no attempt, binding, scope, or receipt.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve the failing evidence; no owner registration repair is permitted inside the case.

cases.purpose: Reject an initially inactive dispatcher principal.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with the owner-inserted dispatcher principal inactive.
cases.method: Insert the dispatcher principal with active=false and launch against an accepted READY job.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no endpoint connection or accepted/outbox/workspace/execution-row change.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and drop the test DB; do not activate the principal after rejection.

cases.purpose: Reject a build with no projector principal.
cases.target: Production worker CLI with deployment/build present and projector principal omitted.
cases.method: Insert deployment/build and dispatcher principal only, accept/provision a READY job, then launch worker mode.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no endpoint connection and unchanged pending outbox, accepted job, workspace, and empty execution rows.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or projection.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and drop the isolated DB; do not insert the missing principal during the case.

cases.purpose: Reject an initially inactive projector principal.
cases.target: Production worker CLI with an inactive projector principal and enabled build.
cases.method: Insert the projector principal with active=false from the start and launch worker mode against an accepted READY job.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero endpoint connections and no job, outbox, workspace, or execution-state mutation.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or projection.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve the rejection evidence; do not activate the principal or retry in the same case.

cases.purpose: Reject a dispatcher deployment with no enabled build mapping.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with deployment/principal present and build omitted.
cases.method: Insert deployment and dispatcher principal only, then run the dispatcher against an accepted READY job.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no endpoint connection and unchanged accepted/outbox/workspace state with no execution rows.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and drop the isolated DB; no build row may be added after rejection.

cases.purpose: Reject a disabled dispatcher build.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with a disabled build and enabled deployment/principal.
cases.method: Insert the build disabled initially and launch the dispatcher against an accepted READY job.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero endpoint connections and unchanged accepted/outbox/workspace state with no attempts or execution rows.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence; do not enable the build and retry within the case.

cases.purpose: Reject a disabled worker build.
cases.target: Production worker CLI with a registered but disabled projector build.
cases.method: Insert deployment/build/principals with the projector build disabled initially, then launch worker mode.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero endpoint connections; no projection or mutation to job/outbox/workspace/execution rows.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or projection.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and discard the isolated DB; do not enable the build during recovery.

cases.purpose: Reject a valid projector credential used in dispatcher mode.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI configured with the projector DB role.
cases.method: Use the real projector DSN in an otherwise valid dispatcher configuration and launch the dispatcher.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no listener connection and no owner-visible dispatch/projection effect.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private SQL/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence; do not grant dispatcher authority to the projector role.

cases.purpose: Reject a valid dispatcher credential used in worker mode.
cases.target: Production worker CLI configured with the dispatcher DB role.
cases.method: Use the real dispatcher DSN in an otherwise valid worker configuration and launch worker mode.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no listener connection and no owner-visible dispatch/projection effect.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or projection.
cases.evidence: Private SQL/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence; do not grant projector authority to the dispatcher role.

cases.purpose: Reject incorrect dispatcher database credentials.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with correct role name and incorrect password.
cases.method: Change only the private DSN password and launch the dispatcher; assert fixed output without exposing DSN or stderr.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no listener connection and no accepted/outbox/workspace/execution-row mutation.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE on SQL authentication failure before Temporal connection.
cases.evidence: Private owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count; no credential bytes in public evidence.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and private configuration; do not publish or echo credentials.

cases.purpose: Reject a same-name dispatcher role recreated with a different PostgreSQL OID.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI after the role is recreated while the immutable registry retains its original role OID.
cases.method: Recreate the role and restore only password/schema/function grants; never update/delete immutable principal/config rows; run dispatcher and restore fixture role credentials/grants during cleanup.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero listener connections and no outbox/job/workspace/execution mutation; immutable registry remains untouched.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE because current role OID is not the registered principal OID.
cases.evidence: Private role OIDs, owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Restore original role password and required grants, preserve evidence, then allow isolated DB teardown; never rewrite the immutable registration.

cases.purpose: Reject an identity whose endpoint/digest conflicts with the registered deployment.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with a valid listener endpoint in config but a different registered endpoint.
cases.method: Register the alternate endpoint and its correct deployment digest, use the passive listener endpoint and its independently recomputed matching digest in config, then launch.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response and zero connections to both the distinct configured and registered passive listeners; job/outbox/workspace/execution state unchanged.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before connecting to either selected endpoint.
cases.evidence: Private identity documents/digests, owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and named configured/registered listener counts recorded both after CLI exit and during cleanup.
cases.recovery: Preserve private evidence; do not change registry endpoint or weaken the independently recomputed digest.

cases.purpose: Reject a configuration namespace that differs from the deployment registration.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with matching deployment endpoint but a distinct config namespace and valid recomputed digest.
cases.method: Register the original namespace, configure a different namespace with its correctly recomputed deployment digest, and launch.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no passive-listener connection and no SQL/workspace execution-state change.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private registry/config identity digests, owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence; do not rewrite namespace registration or config after the attempted start.

cases.purpose: Reject a configuration naming a different deployment ID with valid digest material.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI whose config deployment ID has no corresponding owner registration.
cases.method: Keep a valid registered deployment, configure a distinct deployment ID with a correctly recomputed digest, and launch.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; zero listener connection and unchanged accepted/outbox/workspace/execution state.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private config/registry hashes, owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence; do not add a deployment mapping for the configured ID.

cases.purpose: Reject a dispatcher identity whose build differs from the initially registered build.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with a deployment registered for a different build ID.
cases.method: Insert only the alternate build and dispatcher principal initially, retain the expected build in the config, and launch.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no listener connection or change to accepted/outbox/workspace/execution state.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE on identity/build comparison before Temporal connection or claim.
cases.evidence: Private build/config digests, owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and discard the DB; do not add the expected build or projector mapping after failure.

cases.purpose: Reject a worker identity whose expected build has no corresponding projector mapping.
cases.target: Production worker CLI with an alternate registered build/principal and the expected build in config.
cases.method: Insert the alternate build and bind the projector principal to it, then launch worker mode configured for the expected build.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no passive endpoint connection, projection, or job/outbox/workspace/execution mutation.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE before Temporal connection or projection.
cases.evidence: Private build/config digests, owner/workspace snapshots, process journal/output digests, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve evidence and drop the isolated DB; do not remap the projector principal.

cases.purpose: Reject a private source manifest that does not match the identity hash.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with a tampered private copy of the source manifest.
cases.method: Add a synthetic untrusted file digest to the private manifest copy while retaining the original identity/source hash, then launch.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no listener connection and no accepted/outbox/workspace/execution-state mutation.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE during fail-closed local manifest validation before Temporal connection.
cases.evidence: Private original/altered manifest hashes, process journal/output digests, SQL/workspace snapshots, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve the tampered private test artifact; do not alter product source or expected manifest hash.

cases.purpose: Reject a private environment manifest that does not match the identity hash.
cases.target: Production dispatcher CLI with a tampered private copy of the environment manifest.
cases.method: Add a synthetic untrusted module digest to the private manifest copy while retaining the original identity/environment hash, then launch.
cases.pass_criteria: Fixed code-3 response; no listener connection and no accepted/outbox/workspace/execution-state mutation.
cases.expected: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE during fail-closed local manifest validation before Temporal connection.
cases.evidence: Private original/altered manifest hashes, process journal/output digests, SQL/workspace snapshots, and listener count.
cases.recovery: Preserve the tampered private test artifact; do not alter product source or expected manifest hash.

expected.missing_projector_build_variant: Not representable with a projector principal present because worker_principals(deployment_id,build_id) has a foreign key to engine_builds(deployment_id,build_id). Coverage uses a missing projector principal, disabled projector build, and mismatched projector-build identity instead.
expected.omitted_permutations: No full Cartesian product across every invalid deployment/principal/build/config dimension is attempted. The literal variants isolate one startup rejection condition at a time; dispatcher and worker paths are both covered, but not every condition in both modes.
residual_risks: These cases are authored but not executed; CLI output, timing, passive-listener behavior, SQL snapshot preservation, and teardown remain unverified.
The startup watchdog's 25-second body budget includes real G4/G5 fixture setup; actual host timing must be established by the approved full gate.
The exact runner phase integration and authorization are pending; this file is not independently runnable as an accepted gate.
